description: EPLDataflowTypes differential chain over dataflow type declarations: bean-type (ordinal 0) replays EPLDataflowBeanType where a DefaultSupportSourceOp instruction carrying one SupportBean{theString=E1, intPrimitive=1} fans a single source out over outstream<SupportBean> to two capture sinks, the bean-collecting MySupportBeanOutputOp and the generic SupportGenericOutputOpWPort whose recorded port list pins delivery on port 0; map-type (ordinal 1) replays EPLDataflowMapType where the @public create map schema MyMap (p0 String, p1 int) is deployed to a path first and the flow is compiled against that path, fanning one HashMap{p0=E1, p1=1} source instruction over outstream<MyMap> to MyMapOutputOp and a signal-delimited DefaultSupportCaptureOp whose batch 0 is observed; both executions drain a blocking EPDataFlowInstance.run() and their captures are read after COMPLETE, so each case contributes two post-run capture records with the custom op sink first and the second sink second, and no send steps exist because the inputs are baked source instructions.
